_about.purpose: SVG normalization mapping SoT — drives scripts/tools/normalize_svg.py.
_about.scope: Covers every class / oklch / literal hex / rgba value present in docs/design_handoff/assets/ as enumerated 2026-05-09 (plan revision v2).
_about.owner: phase 8 (ui-theme-assets). Designer updates to docs/design_handoff/assets/ require re-running normalize_svg.py --scan and patching this file before SvgImportSmokeTest can pass.
_about.tokens_ref: docs/UI_GUIDE.md §1.1·§1.2 (oklch column included) — token oklch values resolve via the token table FIRST. This file's `oklch_extras` MUST NOT duplicate any token oklch with a different hex (sanity-checked by SvgImportSmokeTest).
resolve_order: 1. UI_GUIDE §1.1·§1.2 token table (matches token oklch tuple) → token hex. Token table ALWAYS wins.
2. alpha_variants (matches `<L C H> / <a>` form for token oklch) → mapped rgba.
3. oklch_extras (non-token oklch) → mapped hex. Forbidden to contain token oklch.
5. CSS Color 4 spec conversion (oklch → oklab → linear-sRGB → sRGB) → exit 1 if gamut fail.

oklch_extras._comment: ONLY non-token oklch values (those not in UI_GUIDE §1.1·§1.2). Token oklch (e.g. peach_500 = 0.78 0.155 28, berry_500 = 0.70 0.20 15) MUST be resolved from the token table, not from this section. Sanity test fails if a token oklch appears here.

alpha_variants._comment: Token oklch values that appear in handoff with alpha (e.g. tinted overlays). Resolved by combining token hex + alpha → rgba(). Token hex from UI_GUIDE §1.2.

class_map._comment: All classes enumerated from handoff. fill='none' + stroke='#3A2A1C' is the default 'k' outline pattern. Designer may override per-class color tokens; placeholder choices below favor consistency with §1.2 brand palette.

stop._note: Class 'stop' is just a marker on <stop> elements; its color comes from stop-color attribute. Normalizer does NOT inline fill/stroke for this class — stop-color attribute already carries the value (handled by oklch / literal pipeline).

literal_color_map._comment: Token-external literal hex appearing in handoff. Lowercase. Mapped to the nearest UI_GUIDE §1.1·§1.2 token to unify drift. Designer can move entries to allowed_literals to preserve specific visual intent.

allowed_literals._comment: Token-external literals preserved verbatim (designer intent retained — gloss highlights, pure white).

rgba_handling._comment: rgba() and oklch white-alpha (oklch(1 0 0 / a)) pass through verbatim. Godot 4 SVG importer accepts rgba(). Brand gloss inset uses rgba(255,255,255,0.45).

color_attribute_scope._comment: Attributes / contexts the normalizer scans and rewrites. Smoke test sanity uses the same list.

sanity_invariants._comment: Asserted by tests/SvgImportSmokeTest.gd. Failing any of these blocks phase 8 complete.
invariants: no key in oklch_extras may equal any token oklch value listed in UI_GUIDE §1.1 or §1.2 (oklch column)

every fill/stroke/stop-color/flood-color/lighting-color/color hex in normalized assets/**/*.svg must be in (UI_GUIDE token hex set ∪ oklch_extras values ∪ literal_color_map values ∪ allowed_literals.values)
no production SVG may contain `oklch(`, `class="`, or `<style`
every class in handoff SVG must have a class_map entry

every alpha_variants key MUST resolve via alpha_variants step (step 2 of resolve_order) — token+alpha values cannot fall through to generic CSS Color 4 conversion (test asserts each alpha_variants entry is hit at least once when normalizing handoff)
